result.title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
result.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433993
result.summary: A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI [3.65, 4.53]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source model barely decides (AUROC of the source margin 0.90 to 0.97 on ResNet 50, every 95% CI inside [0.89, 0.98]), but our preregistered claim that this holds for every recipe fails on the two mobile networks, where INT8 breaks accuracy outright. A probe set of the 200 training inputs with the smallest source margin, chosen before any conversion, flags all 40 vision stacks (recall 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]) and all 6 text stacks that flip at least 0.5% of decisions and none of the exact FP32 conversions, so conversion checks should compare decisions on such a probe set, not accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT 的 FP32/INT8 配方转换 5 个公开 checkpoint，在 7,854 张图像和 1,938 句子上逐条比对 top-1 决策与 PyTorch 源模型是否一致，发现准确率持平时仍有超过 1% 的决策翻转，并提出以源模型 margin 最小的 200 个训练输入构成 probe set 来检出这类翻转。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「聚合精度不变但逐输入决策改变」的审计设计与 margin 触发的 probe set，可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 推理在量化与数值精度变化下 latent 状态与答案是否稳定；论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 表示，迁移方式需自行核查。
